name: GetManyServiceNowAttachments
label: Get Many ServiceNow Attachments
description: Retrieves multiple attachments from a ServiceNow table or record using a stored credential. Optionally downloads file contents.

fields.name: CredentialId
fields.label: Credential
fields.description: Select the stored ServiceNow credential by ID

fields.name: TableNameOrId
fields.label: Table Name or ID
fields.description: Name of the table (e.g., incident) or sys_id of a record to filter attachments by

fields.name: ReturnAll
fields.label: Return All
fields.description: If enabled, retrieves all attachments across all pages. Otherwise, uses Limit.

fields.name: Limit
fields.label: Limit
fields.description: Maximum number of attachments to retrieve per request (used when Return All is off). Max: 1000.

fields.name: DownloadAttachments
fields.label: Download Attachments
fields.description: If enabled, downloads the binary content of each attachment

fields.name: OutputField
fields.label: Output Field
fields.description: Name of the output field where file data will be stored (e.g., 'data')

fields.name: Response
fields.label: API Response
fields.description: Raw JSON response from ServiceNow API

fields.name: Attachments
fields.label: Attachments
fields.description: List of attachment metadata (sys_id, file_name, content_type, etc.)

fields.name: FileContents
fields.label: File Contents
fields.description: List of byte arrays containing file data (only if Download Attachments is enabled)
